about.quranText: Quran text: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex, Hafs Uthmanic Data v18 (hafsData_v18.json), Hafs an Asim. Bundled exactly as published (only the trailing ayah number is removed); verified by SHA-256.
about.translation: English translation: Saheeh International, via quran-json 3.1.2 (licence review pending).
about.pages: Mushaf pages and lines: Madinah Mushaf, KFGQPC new edition (1441H), line breaks via quran-madina-html (Waqf General Public License 2.0), checked against the Complex's page and line data.
about.fonts: Fonts: Quran — KFGQPC HAFS Uthmanic Script v18 (King Fahd Complex, unmodified, under its licence); interface — IBM Plex Sans Arabic, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
about.prayerAlgo: Prayer times are calculated on the device with standard astronomical formulas (Meeus / USNO) and checked against the independent adhan-js library.
about.tzdb: Time zones: IANA tz database (public domain) via the timezone package.
about.openSource: Open source and free forever. No tracking, no ads, no in-app purchases.

help.title: Help & contact
help.a1: Yes. Rattil has no ads, no subscriptions and no purchases, and it will stay that way.
help.a2: The Quran text, tafsir, prayer times, qibla, adhkar, tasbih and your bookmarks all work offline. Recitations stream from the internet unless you save the surahs first (More → Downloads).
help.q3: Why do the prayer times differ from my mosque?
help.a3: Mosques use different calculation methods and add a few minutes for caution. Choose your country's method and Asr school in the prayer settings, and adjust each prayer by minutes if needed.
help.q4: How do I change the reciter or the speed?
help.a4: In Settings → Recitation, or from the player itself while a recitation is playing.
help.a5: On this phone only: bookmarks, khatma, worship tracker and settings never leave it unless you turn on account sync yourself.
help.q6: Why did the adhan not sound?
help.a6: Allow notifications for Rattil and, on Android, "alarms and reminders". Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery: exclude Rattil from battery optimisation.
help.q7: I found a mistake in a text. What should I do?
help.a7: Use "Report a mistake" under the dhikr, or write to us below. Religious texts come from published sources and go through a review.
help.contactPending: The contact address will be added soon.
